faqs: How much does the Basic AI SEO plan cost?
It starts at ₹10,000 per month. GST is applicable, terms and conditions apply, and the final price depends on the number of pages and any customised work.
When will the targets be reached?
The plan is an ongoing monthly project, with the Domain Authority, Domain Rating and AI Overview targets set for months 10 to 12.
Do you guarantee rankings?
No. We use ethical, industry-standard methods, but search engines change their algorithms, so specific rankings, traffic or revenue cannot be guaranteed.
What access do you need from us?
Manager or admin access to your Google accounts (Search Console, Analytics, Business Profile and others), your social pages and ads accounts, and your website, hosting and DNS.
What costs extra?
ORM, digital PR, premium backlinks, multi-language blogs, international SEO, website development, Google Business Profile management and social media marketing are charged separately.
Is our data kept confidential?
Yes. We do not share or sell your business data or credentials, and access is limited to the people working on your project.
